controller_12m.notes: exists=false confirmed. No Rule 10.07 reference anywhere in the 441-page text (0 hits for '10.07'); the prospectus body consistently uses 'Single Largest Shareholder' (Mr. Yu, ~23.24%) and never designates a Listing-Rules Controlling Shareholder. The Single Largest Shareholder's paragraph (b) undertaking (p.257) only obliges 'reasonable steps' to avoid a disorderly market during the Second Six Month Period — it is not a no-disposal undertaking. The only 12-month restriction is the PRC-law prohibition on ALL existing Shareholders (p.52, p.109), which is not a control undertaking; the p.392 PRC-law summary reference to 'undertakings given by the Company and our controlling shareholder' is generic boilerplate.
